findings.title: Lockout threshold duplicated in the edge function
findings.question: ownership
findings.whatBreaks: The pause threshold (5) is the DB's fact (record_sign_in_failure enforces it); auth-event kept its own LOCK_THRESHOLD=5 to compute attempts-remaining. If the migration threshold were tuned, the enforced value and the displayed count would drift (decisions.md 'kept in sync' smell).
findings.evidence: auth-event/index.ts:20 (const LOCK_THRESHOLD=5), :45 (Math.max(0, LOCK_THRESHOLD-failures)); migrations/010_lockout.sql:31 (if r.failures >= 5).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED before PR. Migration 011 adds sign_in_lock_threshold() (sole owner of 5), record_sign_in_failure reads it, and sign_in_attempts_remaining(p_hash) computes the count in the DB; auth-event drops LOCK_THRESHOLD and the extra read and calls the RPC. ADR-0007. pgTAP added (50_lockout.test.sql, 30_functions_and_grants.test.sql).

findings.title: Global sign-out ran after the throwing audit bookkeeping
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: completePasswordReset called onReset() (clear_sign_in_failures + log_event, which throw on a DB error) BEFORE signOutEverywhere(). If onReset threw, the password was already changed but the global sign-out was skipped and the route (no try/catch) returned a raw 500 - leaving pre-existing sessions alive after a recovery, the exact thing 'end all sessions' defends against.
findings.evidence: passwordReset.ts (pre-fix): onReset() awaited, then signOutEverywhere(); reset-password/route.ts has no try/catch. The edge change+event-atomic rule does not bind this Next route (ADR-0005).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED in a7ea266. signOutEverywhere() now runs BEFORE onReset(), and onReset is best-effort: it reports a DB failure via report() instead of throwing, so a bookkeeping hiccup cannot drop the (already-applied) session revocation. Unit test asserts sign-out precedes the bookkeeping.

findings.title: Fail-open collapses tampered/deleted cookie with absent cookie; the idle/absolute timeout is bypassable at an authenticated workstation, and the ADR overstated the guarantee
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: readActivity returns null on HMAC failure (sessionActivity.ts:93) and on absence; middleware maps any null to allow (middleware.ts:48,56; sessionGate.ts:36). getUser() refreshes the Supabase session each pass, so the activity cookie is the ONLY idle/absolute enforcement; RLS enforces aal2, not session age. An attacker at an unattended workstation can delete tp-activity and the timeout never fires. RESOLVED (not a blind code change — the fail-open is a sound availability choice): (1) ADR-0010 Consequences corrected to state the timeout is best-effort/bypassable by cookie deletion and that RLS does not backstop session age (the prior 'treated by its true age' claim was inaccurate); (2) added a @security fail-open scenario (safe-sessions.feature 'A deleted activity cookie fails open...') so the posture is tested and owned; (3) added a TODO for the fail-closed-after-grace hardening (stamp at sign-in; needs the deferred session registry).

findings.title: Activity route called internalCallSecret() outside any try/catch — a missing INTERNAL_CALL_SECRET threw an unhandled 500 instead of the documented graceful degradation
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: activity/route.ts:36 (pre-fix) read the secret unguarded; internalCallSecret()->requireEnv throws on absence, so a deploy with Supabase env but no INTERNAL_CALL_SECRET returned a generic 500 that bypassed report(), contradicting ADR §Decision ('a missing secret leaves the timeout with no opinion'). RESOLVED: the secret read + sign/read are now wrapped; on failure the route reports at warning and returns 200 {ok:false, reason:'no-session'}, matching the !hasSupabaseEnv() branch and the middleware's fail-open (:39-62). Re-verified: typecheck + production build pass.

findings.title: API-401-triggered expiry always reports cause 'idle', so an absolute-cap expiry reached via an API 401 shows idle copy
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: apiFetch dispatches a bare SESSION_EXPIRED_EVENT with no cause (apiFetch.ts:64); onExpiredEvent -> leave('expired','idle') defaults to idle. Only the client-event path is affected; the middleware redirect path sets the true reason. Impact is wrong heading/body text only. DISCLOSED in ADR-0010 honest limits (threading the cause through the 401 body is a future refinement).

findings.title: Credential-free demo routes reachable in a production build
findings.question: boundary
findings.whatBreaks: The /admin/gallery and /admin/gallery/shell demo surfaces shipped in the production bundle, guarded only by the /admin/* auth middleware rather than removed; a demo route reachable in prod is an unnecessary surface.
findings.evidence: ADR-0013 'Verify headlessly' + Limitations document the routes; judge-arch (fresh-context general-purpose subagent, 2026-11-11) rated it LOW and not a four-questions violation.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED before PR: both gallery pages now call notFound() when process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', so they render only under `next dev` (where the E2E runs) and are absent from a production build. Re-verified: typecheck clean, E2E-13/E2E-14 (6 tests) still pass.

grepCommands: rg -n 'from "@/features' src/components/ui/  -> exit 1 (no ui->features dependency edge)
rg -n -i 'supabase\.(from|rpc)|createClient' src/components/ui/ src/features/shell/  -> exit 1 (no backend access in components)
rg -n 'catch\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{\s*\}|\.catch\(\s*\(\)\s*=>' src/components/ src/features/shell/  -> exit 1 (no swallowed catch)
rg -n '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|rgb\(|hsl\(' src/components/ui/ src/features/shell/ -g '!*.svg'  -> exit 1 (no colour literal in code/CSS; only static SVG art carries hex, n/a to the rule under ADR-0006)
archGate: PASS - npm run check:architecture (arch-gate, no violations); check:design-system OK (14 in-scope changed files, waivers down to the 3 unrelated auth entries); check:routing PASS (3 rules, all artifacts present); check:a11y:checklist OK (55/55); check:no-ua, check:owasp:lints, check:gherkin, check:bdd-tags, check:security-coverage all pass; typecheck + build clean; 238 vitest + 6 Playwright (E2E-13/E2E-14) pass.
reviewContext: Fresh context: dispatched to a judge-arch general-purpose subagent with the scoped staged diff (git diff origin/main --cached, 52 files), decisions.md, ADR-0011/0012/0013, and src/components/AGENTS.md; it returned the full four-questions matrix plus the re-runnable grep battery. Reviewer: agent fresh-context review (judge-arch subagent), 2026-11-11.
verdict: PASS after fix - 1 LOW finding (prod-reachable demo routes), resolved in-branch before the PR by gating both gallery routes to non-production. Zero high/med findings; the four-questions matrix was observed clean across all 36 changed code files (zero ui->features edges, zero backend access in components, zero colour literals in code, zero swallowed catches), and the TP1-06 CSS-module/raw-control waivers are genuinely retired. Limitation: static review of the staged diff plus re-runnable greps; the authenticated shell is exercised only via the mock-AuthProvider demo (ADR-0013 Limitations). The mechanical gates above were run and passed in this session.

scope: Merge resolution: origin/main (which independently migrated the TP1-06 shell to shadcn in #28 and landed the ADR-0014 basePath routing fixes) merged into feat/tp1-07-admin-workspace-shell.
